_comment: Triage for the eShop validation scenario. These are recorded decisions from the adoption run: the detector matched these paths, but they are not boundary violations. They stay in the gate; this file only changes how the adoption summary describes them.

triage.note: Fix exact-type resolution in the detector and add this as a fixture. Do not rename working code to satisfy the match.

triage.reason: The detector skips infrastructure/ case-sensitively, so Infrastructure/ and Ordering.Infrastructure/ are not recognised as infrastructure; all 74 matches are persistence code in infrastructure folders.
